items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Lucci. You know, Tom Albert's son, Albert Jackson, Pinky's father?

ctx.x: Oh, well, at the time when they, when I was with Red Allen, they had, had Red Allen, they had John Casmy, myself, old man Glenny, and a fella by the name of Lucci used to play trombone. What?
Lucci. You know, Tom Albert's son, Albert Jackson, Pinky's father? Yeah, he had a son play trombone too.
Yeah, Pinky. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah, that's right. I knew him and Tom Albert too.
